mapper.select: SELECT ssl.execution_yyyymm , ssl.log_seq_no , ssl.application_user_id , (SELECT NVL(full_name_local,english_full_name) FROM lgcom_user_m_v WHERE application_user_id = ssl.application_user_id) AS employee_name , mm.system_code , mm.module_code , ssl.menu_id , mm.menu_name , ssl.program_id , pm.program_name , ssl.system_service_desc , SUBSTR(ssl.system_service_desc,INSTR(ssl.system_service_desc, '/', -1) + 1) AS service_name , TO_CHAR(ssl.actual_start_timestamp,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS actual_start_time , TO_CHAR(ssl.actual_end_timestamp,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS actual_end_time , TRUNC(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM(ssl.actual_end_timestamp - ssl.actual_start_timestamp)) * 60 * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM(ssl.actual_end_timestamp - ssl.actual_start_timestamp)) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM(ssl.actual_end_timestamp - ssl.actual_start_timestamp)),2) AS execution_time FROM LGCOM_SYSTEM_SERVICE_LOGGING_N ssl , LGCOM_MENU_M mm , LGCOM_PROGRAM_M pm WHERE ssl.execution_yyyymm = REPLACE(#{executionYyyymm},'-','') AND ssl.menu_id = #{menuId} AND ssl.program_id = #{programId} AND ssl.system_service_desc = #{systemServiceDesc} AND ssl.menu_id = mm.menu_id(+) AND ssl.program_id = pm.program_id(+) ORDER BY ssl.execution_yyyymm, ssl.application_user_id, ssl.actual_start_timestamp
